description: The Mendeley version 2 deposit contains cell-level and module-level characterization measurements for lithium battery modules made from three parallel-connected cells. The University of Michigan Battery Lab first aged seventy cells to create a range of cell health states and then assembled 78 modules with different average state of health and within-module variation. Repository metadata describe measurements at 25 degrees Celsius under 0.5C and 0.25C conditions and list 395 CSV entries, including repeated filenames in different repository paths. Mendeley states CC BY 4.0. This is laboratory input for module ageing or current-sharing models, not fleet failure rates or a forecast for a specific battery installation. One cell technology, deliberately assembled module combinations and selected current conditions are limitations for wider storage systems. A reviewer-assessed use is testing how cell imbalance changes simulated usable capacity. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related system-level storage model; no direct input mapping was tested. No CSV payload was downloaded. Coverage is one controlled University of Michigan laboratory campaign.
